{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify QA orders: revenue = '999,999.99'
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999,999.99'
qa_orders = df[qa_mask]

# Print the count of QA orders
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue == '999,999.99'): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Print their status
print(f"Status distribution of QA orders: {qa_orders['status'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[~qa_mask]

# Count completed orders in clean data
completed_count_clean = (df_clean['status'] == 'completed').sum()

# Print the final count
print(f"Number of actual completed orders (after removing QA rows): {completed_count_clean}")"}
